revision_selection.objective: Select and pin exact maintained source, target, and QEMU revisions for the confirmed driver. Return {schema_version:1,migration_envelope_sha256,repositories:[{role,platform,url,requested_ref,selection_rule}],compatibility_evidence:[{source_url,claim,excerpt,claim_kind,bindings:[{role,requested_ref}]}]}. An excerpt is an evidence summary, not a required byte-for-byte substring.

evidence_closure.objective: Propose the smallest task-relevant acquisition closure. Return {schema_version:1,migration_envelope_sha256,repository_manifest_sha256,facets:[{lane,facet,disposition,rationale,locators,gap?}]}; cover all six Skill lanes, use CONTROLLED with content locators or EXPLICIT_GAP with {reason,impact,repair_trigger}, and include the frozen source driver entry.

environment_recovery.objective: Select the least-cost concrete QEMU experiment route supported by the frozen environment evidence. Return {schema_version:3,route_id,milestone:EXPERIMENT_READY,purpose,artifact_mode,device_identity,topology,command:[...],cwd,environment,timeout_seconds,accepted_exit_codes,runner_evidence_paths,relevance_evidence,driver_insertion_or_packaging_path?}. Do not assume QMP, a full source build, or a particular packaging mode.

knowledge_base.objective: Create the mandatory target-specific knowledge probe plan from controlled originals. If compliance_recheck is present, revise the complete plan to close every KNOWLEDGE finding using directly inspected target originals. Return only one schema_version=1 object containing the complete probes array.

target_platform_study.objective: Complete Skill Phase 2 from pinned target originals. Return {profile_json,api_table,analogous_trace,change_plan}. profile_json answers the nine template sections; api_table has entries; analogous_trace contains only applicable Skill steps in Skill order; change_plan records the lowest necessary integration level. Do not return Markdown because the controller renders it.

source_closure.objective: Close the behaviorally required source set using frozen compile commands. Return one object with schema_version, source_root, source_revision, closure_status:CLOSED, compiler, defines, include_paths, configuration_inputs, generated_headers, selected_conditional_branches, translation_units, closure_categories, and unresolved_dependencies:[]; each translation unit includes unit_id, source_path, sha256, compile_directory, arguments, and dependencies.

migration_contracts.objective: Build Skill Phase 4 behaviorally relevant migration contracts from the frozen evidence. Cite existing hardware/source/QEMU chunks; cite target evidence only as {api_id}. Map relevant source functions and record explicit gaps. Return {schema_version:1, contracts:[...], gaps:[...]}.

test_adaptation.objective: Build Skill Phase 5 public developer test mappings. Classify every discovered source test or assertion, preserve portable device intent, and record exclusions or blockers honestly. Return the complete test matrix as JSON.

driver_implementation.objective: Implement Skill Phase 6 directly in the writable target worktree. Reconstruct the evidenced driver behavior, adapt retained public tests, and make only necessary target changes. Return {schema_version:2,file_roles:[{path,role}],coverage:[...],target_changes:[...],target_symbols:[{api_id}],unsafe_obligations:[...]}; every non-test coverage item includes unit_ids and source_references:[{unit_id,fact_ids}], and the controller derives exact source spans, paths, and hashes. On repair, unchanged collections may be null. Do not build or run QEMU.

target_compliance.objective: Perform only Skill Phase 7 against the current implementation and pinned target originals. Do not inspect factory code, edit, compile, run QEMU, or plan Phase 8. Return {schema_version:2, status:PASS|VIOLATION|UNKNOWN, evidence:[...], findings:[{repair_target,summary,implementation_paths,target_evidence}]}; PASS has no findings.

artifact_preparation.objective: Plan only artifact preparation in Skill Phase 8. Return {schema_version:2, plan_id, artifact_mode, cwd, steps:[command], runtime_artifact, base_artifact, presence_check:command, tool_evidence_paths:[]}; command is {argv,environment,timeout_seconds,accepted_exit_codes}. Do not assume a fixed step sequence or packaged test artifact.

public_qemu_validation.objective: Freeze applicable public Skill Phase 8 QEMU evidence. Return {schema_version:2,runs:[{run_id,purpose,contract_ids,test_ids,cwd,command,oracle,qemu_evidence}],ladder:[{level,disposition,run_ids,rationale}]}. A command is {argv,environment,timeout_seconds,accepted_exit_codes} and must invoke a harness/checker that evaluates the predeclared oracle; exit status alone is never the oracle. Use NOT_APPLICABLE or BLOCKED honestly; do not assume packet fields or QMP and do not use private tests.

public_repair.objective: Perform one narrow Skill Phase 9 diagnosis from the frozen failed public run. For a writable defect, edit the target worktree directly. Return {schema_version:2, attribution, action:APPLY|BLOCKED, failure_run_ids, summary, evidence, implementation}; implementation uses the Phase 6 response shape for APPLY and is null for BLOCKED. Do not emit a patch or use private evidence.
